title: lawmadi-os
description: Verify Korean legal citations against law.go.kr: precedents, statutes, bar-exam answers.
summary: Verify Korean legal citations against law.go.kr: precedents, statutes, bar-exam answers.
offersHint: Verify Korean legal citations against law.go.kr: precedents, statutes, bar-exam answers. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://lawmadi.com/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key>. Issue one at https://lawmadi.com/expert-console after signing in. Discovery (initialize/tools/list) and the get_pricing tool work without it.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <API key>. Issue one at https://lawmadi.com/expert-console after signing in. Discovery (initialize/tools/list) and the get_pricing tool work without it.

toolsPreview.name: ask
toolsPreview.description: Ask a Korean legal question. Routes to 1 of 60 specialist AI legal leaders and returns a statute-verified analysis (real-time law.go.kr check). Supports Korean and English.

toolsPreview.name: ask_expert
toolsPreview.description: Expert mode legal analysis — runs the full verification pipeline for a more detailed, deeply-cited answer. Slower than `ask`.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search Korean statutes, precedents and legal terms via law.go.kr. Returns matching law topics.

toolsPreview.name: get_leaders
toolsPreview.description: List all 60+ specialist legal leaders with their names and specialties.

toolsPreview.name: chat_leader
toolsPreview.description: Chat 1:1 with a specific legal leader. Provide the leader_id (e.g. 'L01', 'L32', 'CCO') from get_leaders.

toolsPreview.name: suggest_questions
toolsPreview.description: Generate relevant follow-up legal questions for a given query.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_precedent
toolsPreview.description: Look up a Korean court case by docket number in Lawmadi's verified-asset corpus (11,018 precedents, each confirmed against law.go.kr). Returns court, decision date, case name, holding (판시사항), summary (판결요지), referenced articles and a direct law.go.kr full-text link. Deterministic — no LLM, no hallucination. Accepts '2020도3050', '대법원 2020. 3. 26. 선고 2020도3050 판결', or '2016헌마90'.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_statute
toolsPreview.description: Look up a Korean statute article in Lawmadi's verified-asset corpus (30,995 articles). Returns the article title, body text and law.go.kr link. Deterministic — no LLM. Example input: '민법 제750조', '형법 제307조 제1항'.

toolsPreview.name: verify_citations
toolsPreview.description: Fact-check the Korean legal citations inside any text — including text another LLM produced. Extracts every statute article and case docket, then checks each one against Lawmadi's verified-asset corpus. Returns per-citation status (verified_in_corpus / not_in_corpus) with source links. Deterministic, no LLM. IMPORTANT: 'not_in_corpus' means the citation is NOT in this corpus — it is a flag to check manually at law.go.kr, not proof that the citation is fabricated.

toolsPreview.name: bar_exam_search
toolsPreview.description: Search the Korean bar exam (변호사시험) corpus — all 15 rounds, 2,340 questions (2,250 MCQ + 45 case-type + 45 record-type) with gold-standard answers whose citations passed law.go.kr verification. Query by docket ('2014도6992'), statute article ('형법 제310조') or keyword. Returns round, subject, question number, official answer, stem, cited statutes/cases and a link.

toolsPreview.name: get_exam_answer
toolsPreview.description: Fetch ONE bar-exam question with its full gold answer. MCQ (선택형): pass round + subject + no → official stem, all five choices, the Ministry of Justice answer key, the reasoning, a note per choice, and the cited statutes/precedents. Essay (사례형) and record-type (기록형): pass round + subject + format → document type, outline and the full answer text. Every citation passed law.go.kr verification before publishing. One item per call — this corpus is proprietary and not available for bulk export.

toolsPreview.name: get_daily_content
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one published daily post in full-record form: 오늘의 법률상식(daily — includes the verified statute list and the FAQ), 전략 칼럼(strategy) / 기술 칼럼(tech) with their live-checked references, 리걸테크 뉴스(news) with source domains, 수험 판례 강의노트(bar), 오늘의 판례(precedent — enriched with the verified case record). Pass a date, or omit it for the latest post in that stream.

toolsPreview.name: list_document_types
toolsPreview.description: List the legal document types Lawmadi can draft (고소장·소장·내용증명·답변서·탄원서·합의서·법률의견서 etc.), with Korean and English labels.

toolsPreview.name: generate_document
toolsPreview.description: Draft a Korean legal document (complaint, civil petition, content-certified mail, answer brief, settlement agreement, legal opinion, …) from the user's facts. Every statute/precedent citation in the draft goes through the same fail-closed law.go.kr verification as `ask`. Use list_document_types first for valid doc_type keys.

toolsPreview.name: search_legal_forms
toolsPreview.description: Search official Korean statutory forms and appendix tables (별표·서식) served by law.go.kr — e.g. the exact form to file an application under a given act.

toolsPreview.name: find_village_lawyer
toolsPreview.description: Find the Ministry of Justice '마을변호사' (village lawyer) assigned to a Korean locality — a free legal-consultation contact point. Search by province, city or township name (e.g. '강원 강릉', '은평구'). Public data, no LLM.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: How to get access and what it costs. Returns the sign-up flow, where to issue an API key, the free allowance, credit-pack prices (KRW/USD), what one credit buys, and direct checkout links. **Callable without authentication** — an AI agent arriving for the first time should call this to learn how to obtain access.

toolsPreview.name: get_account
toolsPreview.description: Your account status for the API key in use — remaining credits, plan, and a top-up link. Call this before a long run of metered queries so you can purchase in advance instead of hitting an exhausted balance mid-task.

toolsPreview.name: latest_content
toolsPreview.description: Get Lawmadi's latest daily legal content — 오늘의 법률상식(daily), 전략 칼럼(strategy), 기술 칼럼(tech), 리걸테크 뉴스(news), 수험 판례 강의노트(bar), 오늘의 판례(precedent). Every post passed its publishing gate (statute/precedent citations verified against law.go.kr, sources live-checked).
